# Microbiome_Metabolomics_HIV

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This repository includes data, R codes and outputs for the manuscript **A taxon-specific measurement of disruption in a multi-modal study of microbiomes and metabolomes reveals system-wide dysbiosis preceding HIV-1 infection**. 

Please follow the the main script  *code/data_analysis_workflow.R* to run all the analyses.


Please refer to the *data availability* in the paper to obtain the metadata for this project
